primitive.$description: Primitive tier: raw scale values with no semantic meaning. NOT the public contract (BR-BW-TOK-001): names may change between minors. Colour ramps seeded from Radix Colors, converted to oklch (BR-BW-TOK-003); non-colour scales seeded from Open Props. Semantic tokens reference these; consumers reference the semantic tier, never these.

chart.$description: Categorical data-series ramp (ADR-082). Unlike the hue ramps above this is a set of eight mutually-distinguishable series colours, not a lightness scale of one hue: 'light'/'dark' are the two authored themes (BR-BW-TOK-002), not scale steps. Hue is invariant per series across both themes because a series' identity is its hue; only lightness and chroma are authored per theme. Every value satisfies six properties verified in tests, all measured on the colour a browser actually paints rather than the authored value: renderable within sRGB without clipping, an all-pairs separation floor of 0.12 in oklab across the retint envelope, a minimum 28 degree hue separation, WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 against its own theme's surface, hue stability across themes, and a minimum 0.08 separation from the axis and axis-label chrome tokens (a series must not read as the chart's own axis furniture). Solved under all constraints simultaneously with a MARGIN inside the sRGB gamut boundary (every channel keeps at least 0.005 of linear-sRGB headroom), not merely inside it: a value sitting on the boundary survives only until the next rounding of its own literal. Colour-vision deficiency is a ranked objective in the solve rather than an afterthought: the palette is not guaranteed distinguishable under dichromacy (no eight-colour palette can be), but among candidates meeting every hard constraint the one with the best dichromatic separation is chosen. See ADR-082 Decision 5.

size.$description: Non-colour primitives (Open Props-derived). Spacing scale, radii, icon sizes, control heights. Density axis (semantic tier) selects between these; direction is handled by logical CSS properties, not a token (BR-BW-TOK-005).

step.$description: ADR-125: kit-wide unitless step multipliers applied to the density control base. Starting ratios; xs and xl ship on a component only where that component earns them. Not a universal root: type, space and radius are computed within their own axes.

text-step.$description: ADR-125 and ADR-126 section 4: unitless multipliers applied to the label type size so a control's text follows its step. Deliberately gentler than the box multipliers (--bw-size-step-*): type has a legibility floor, so xs may not fall to 0.75 of the label (10.5 px at the 14 px label). The resolved size is clamped to --bw-font-size-xs. Starting ratios; the shape is fixed.

control-height.$description: ADR-125: computed, never authored per step. density control height x step multiplier, clamped to the 1.5rem WCAG 2.5.8 floor (md is the base and is not clamped). Re-emitted inside every [data-density] block so a density scoped to a subtree re-resolves the whole scale.

control-padding-inline.$description: ADR-125: density control padding base x step multiplier. Re-emitted inside every [data-density] block.

control-icon.$description: ADR-126 section 4: icon box inside a control, by step. md is the base icon (the 1rem component icon); the other steps are that base times the shared step multiplier, so an icon follows its control's step (ADR-125 section 5). Density does not change it. Re-emitted inside every [data-density] block beside the other resolved control tokens.

control-gap.$description: ADR-126 section 4: gap between a control's icon and label (or between its inner parts), by step. Aliases the space ramp, so it is a named choice per step rather than a multiplier: xs space-1-5, sm and md space-2, lg and xl space-3. Re-emitted inside every [data-density] block.

control-font-size.$description: ADR-126 section 4: label type size inside a control, by step. md is the label role size (--bw-text-label-size, the type ramp's label); the other steps are that size times --bw-size-text-step-<step>, clamped to the --bw-font-size-xs legibility floor (TYP-022), so text resizes with the box, the icon and the gap. Density does not change it. Re-emitted inside every [data-density] block beside the other resolved control tokens.

control.$description: ADR-126 section 4: the four control role variables. Every control reads only these and never a density or step token directly. They default to the resolved md tokens; a size class (bw-<component>--size-<step>) or a control container re-points them for its subtree. Not a public option and not a new axis: authors still write size. Emitted on :root and re-emitted inside every [data-density] block so a density scoped to a subtree re-resolves them.
